title: Expressions Using Our Head and Shoulders

source.name: VOA Learning English — Expressions Using Our Head and Shoulders
source.license: Nội dung của VOA (Voice of America), phạm vi công cộng
source.note: Đã rút gọn: chỉ giữ một số đoạn.

paras: Many English expressions and idioms use parts of the body to describe things unrelated to the body. For example, a green thumb means to be good at growing vegetables, flowers and other plants. And if something costs an arm and a leg , it is very expensive .
Well, today, we talk about your shoulder. This part connects your arm to your body. And the shoulder finds its way into many expressions.
For starters, let’s talk about “shoulder” as a verb. If you shoulder something, you accept it as your responsibility; you give support, or you take the blame.
Since he was the leader of the project, he shouldered the blame for its failure.
For example, during difficult times in our lives, it is often necessary to have a shoulder to lean on or a shoulder to cry on .
When we lean on someone’s shoulder , we ask for their help. When we cry on someone’s shoulder , they are there for support.

It is important to have at least one friend who has a good shoulder to cry on . These friends are great because they don't ask questions. They just listen and let us cry. You can also put your head on someone’s shoulder . This means you are getting comfort and support from that person.

There is another way our shoulders give us support. If you are successful in your career but others have come before you, you can say you are standing on the shoulders of giants . This means you have not succeeded on your own. You have learned from others in the same field who had earlier successes.

If you have a good head on your shoulders, you are thoughtful and smart. You do the right thing, and people can count on you. When you have a good head on your shoulders , you often achieve success in life.
This quality, people say, often puts you head and shoulders above the rest . This means you are much better than those in a similar field or competition.

You have applied for a job. You have more education and much more experience than the job requires. You also have special skills that make you even more desirable. You feel these factors put you head and shoulders above the other candidates.

questions.q: A goalkeeper says, “I will shoulder the responsibility for this defeat.” What does he mean?
options: He accepts that he is the one who must take the blame
He thinks he is a better player than all of the others
He wants someone to comfort him after the match has ended
He plans to learn from the champions of earlier years
questions.explain: Đoạn 3–5: to shoulder something = nhận trách nhiệm/chịu lỗi (ví dụ: trưởng dự án “shouldered the blame”).

questions.q: According to the writer, why is a friend with “a good shoulder to cry on” valuable?
options: Such a friend helps you to win competitions and to be better than others
Such a friend always gives clever advice and tells you exactly what to do
Such a friend pays for expensive things when you do not have the money
Such a friend gives comfort by listening without asking many questions
questions.explain: Đoạn 8: những người bạn đó “don’t ask questions. They just listen and let us cry”.

questions.q: A scientist says, “My discovery was possible because I am standing on the shoulders of giants.” What is she saying?
options: She is much taller than any of the colleagues she works with
She has succeeded completely on her own, without any help
Her success is built on the work of earlier researchers
She is afraid of being blamed for a failure in her laboratory
questions.explain: Đoạn 9: standing on the shoulders of giants = thành công nhờ học từ những người đi trước, không phải tự mình làm nên.

questions.q: Which person has “a good head on his shoulders”?
options: A young man who always tells friends his problems
A boy who beat all other competitors by a long way
A student who takes the blame for his team’s mistakes
A sensible teenager whom adults trust to make wise choices
questions.explain: Đoạn 10: a good head on your shoulders = chín chắn, thông minh, làm điều đúng và người khác tin cậy được.

questions.q: What does the job-application example show about “head and shoulders above” the others?
options: The applicant needs help from a friend
The applicant is much taller than the others
The applicant has little experience for the job
The applicant is clearly better qualified than the rest
questions.explain: Đoạn 11–12: người có nhiều học vấn và kinh nghiệm hơn hẳn → “head and shoulders above the other candidates” = vượt trội rõ rệt.

questions.q: Some English idioms use parts of the body to talk about things that have nothing to do with the body.
questions.explain: Đoạn 1: nhiều thành ngữ dùng bộ phận cơ thể để miêu tả những điều không liên quan đến cơ thể.

questions.q: The expression “a shoulder to cry on” is used more often in American English than in British English.
questions.explain: Bài không so sánh cách dùng giữa tiếng Anh Mỹ và Anh.

str.s: If you are …, but …, you can say …
